what_human_must_do: Enter your email and click the confirmation link in your inbox.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the RAX Finance homepage Go to rax.finance and read the three product sections: Pledge & Mint, the RAX Compute Market and the RAX Regional Compute Index.
2 Step 2 : Join the waitlist Select Join the waitlist on the homepage, which leads to the RAX waitlist page .
3 Step 3 : Study the compute market panel Look at how the homepage presents open orders priced per cT, where one cT equals one GPU-hour, to see how the market is meant to work.
4 Step 4 : Return to the homepage for updates The site reads "Coming soon", so check rax.finance again to see whether the app has opened.
